chroma.head: 🟩 Green screen removal
chroma.toggleTitle: Toggle green screen removal for this clip
chroma.sensTitle: Higher removes more — but may eat into the subject
chroma.tip: 💡 Removal applies at render (FFmpeg) — the web preview does not show it yet. The background needs to be evenly colored and well lit for a clean removal.

bgremove.desc: AI separates the subject from the background (rembg + BiRefNet, running 100% on your machine, no video sent anywhere). The result has a transparent background — place it on a track above to composite.
bgremove.optAuto: Auto (birefnet, falls back to u2net on error)
bgremove.confirm:
Remove the video background with AI (runs locally, may take a few minutes)?
The result is a transparent-background video replacing the current clip.

bgremove.done: Done! The clip now uses "{name}" (transparent background, session {session}).

effect.tips: 💡 Effects apply top to bottom. See the result after rendering.
